items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Buck starts to work with Timmy Rogers and his band.

ctx.x: over there for those 10 days and I was going to try to make up a foundation over there for Buck and Bubbles and send him his fare to come on over there instead of trying to break out on that low-paying salary trying to get Buck and Bubbles on in America. And I'd start over there for nothing. I'd be better off, that was my thought. You know?

So, I ain't got no one to work with and Buck starts to work with Timmy Rogers and his band. I got a clipping out of the paper and I got another clipping where Buck said that he was planning on doing an act without me before I'd even thought about it.
Well, what happened is, when I go with Bob Hope, man, that did it. Bob Hope himself had to congratulate me from what he thought about negroes to what he found out in me.
